# id: # Construction methods from the OSRS Wiki training pages and the Ironman / Ultimate Ironman guides (see source). "?" = rate not on the wiki; "our estimate" = xp per hour divided by xp each.

name: Daddy's Home quest
note: One-time Construction xp: 944 on the Construction training page but 544 in the Ironman guide. The Ironman guide says the quest needs 5 bolts of cloth.
source: OSRS Wiki Construction training; Ironman Guide/Construction 2026-11-11

name: Tower of Life quest
note: One-time 1,000 Construction xp per the Ironman guide; the quest requires Construction 10.

name: Building starter furniture (levels 1-33)
where: Player-owned house (Parlour, Kitchen, Workshop, Dining room)
note: Per-build xp from the wiki table includes crude wooden chair 58, wooden bookcase 115 and wooden larder 228. Regular planks need steel nails; oak planks are used from level 15. No per-hour rate is given.
source: OSRS Wiki Construction training; Ironman Guide/Construction 2026-11-11

name: Repairing Wintertodt braziers
note: Construction xp is 4x current Construction level per repair, useful roughly from level 4 to 27 per the wiki. The Ironman guide says to train Construction to 20 first for the most benefit. Firemaking requirements are not stated on the pages read.
source: OSRS Wiki Construction training; Ironman Guide/Construction 2026-11-11

name: Mahogany Homes contracts
where: Contracts from Amy (Falador), Marlo (Varrock), Ellie (East Ardougne) and Angelo (Hosidius)
note: Tiers: Beginner 1, Novice 20, Adept 50, Expert 70. Rates are from a model-extracted summary of the Construction training page (Beginner 35k-50k up to Expert 185k-210k). The Ironman and UIM summaries give about 72k-85k with tick manipulation or ring of the elements, so the sources conflict.
source: OSRS Wiki Construction training; Ironman Guide/Construction; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Construction 2026-11-11

name: Building oak furniture in a player-owned house (UIM)
note: UIM guide summary: up to about 40,000 xp/h (50,000 with tick manipulation) at about 4 coins per xp, with oak planks from the Varrock sawmill by balloon or ring of the elements. The rate is from the summary, not verbatim text.

name: Making oak larders in a kitchen
note: Each oak larder takes 8 oak planks for 480 xp (60 per plank). The Construction training page summary gives up to about 500,000 xp/h. The Ironman guide also names level 33 for oak larders.
source: OSRS Wiki Construction training; Ironman Guide/Construction 2026-11-11

name: Mounted mythical capes
note: Ironman guide: from 50 Construction (needs Dragon Slayer II), each plank gives 123 xp with the cape bonus rather than 90. The Construction training page summary gives up to about 430,000 xp/h (about 370 xp per cape).
source: OSRS Wiki Ironman Guide/Construction; Construction training 2026-11-11

name: Mahogany tables
note: Six mahogany planks per table (140 xp each, 840 per table). The Construction training page summary gives up to about 900,000 xp/h. The Ironman guide also names level 52.
source: OSRS Wiki Construction training; Ironman Guide/Construction 2026-11-11

name: Teak garden benches
note: Six teak planks per bench (90 xp each, 540 per bench). The Construction training page summary gives 500,000-600,000 xp/h typical. The Ironman guide also names level 66 and the Superior garden.
source: OSRS Wiki Construction training; Ironman Guide/Construction 2026-11-11

name: Gnome benches
note: Six mahogany planks per bench (840 xp each). The Construction training page summary says just over 1.1M xp/h. The item name "gnome bench" was not checked against a wiki page title.
